description: Defines an abstract class LayoutPullParser implementing ILegacyPullParser for XML parsing in Android rendering tools.

classes.name: LayoutPullParser
classes.description: An abstract class for XML parsing in Android layout rendering, implementing ILegacyPullParser.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Throws XmlPullParserException indicating the method is not supported.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns null for any property name.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Throws XmlPullParserException indicating the method is not supported.

methods.name: defineEntityReplacementText
methods.description: Throws XmlPullParserException indicating the method is not supported.

methods.name: getNamespacePrefix
methods.description: Throws XmlPullParserException indicating the method is not supported.

methods.name: getInputEncoding
methods.description: Returns 'UTF-8'.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException indicating the method is not supported.

methods.name: getNamespaceCount
methods.description: Throws XmlPullParserException indicating the method is not supported.

methods.name: getNamespaceUri
methods.description: Throws XmlPullParserException indicating the method is not supported.

methods.name: getColumnNumber
methods.description: Returns -1.

methods.name: getLineNumber
methods.description: Returns -1.

methods.name: getAttributeType
methods.description: Returns 'CDATA' for attribute type.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns an empty string.

methods.name: getTextCharacters
methods.description: Returns null.

methods.name: isAttributeDefault
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns true for FEATURE_PROCESS_NAMESPACES and FEATURE_REPORT_NAMESPACE_ATTRIBUTES, false otherwise.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Sets features; throws XmlPullParserException for unsupported features.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns current parsing state.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances parser state; calls abstract methods based on current state.

methods.name: nextTag
methods.description: Advances to next start or end tag; throws exception if not.

methods.name: nextText
methods.description: Reads text content of current element; throws exception if not on START_TAG.

methods.name: nextToken
methods.description: Calls next() method.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Checks if current event matches expected type, namespace, and name; throws exception otherwise.
